title: Do Not Drink Advisory — Hospital-Wide PA Announcement

fields.text: Attention all staff. A Do Not Drink advisory is in effect for the hospital. Do not drink or use tap water for drinking or oral care. Bottled water is at every nurses' station and the main entrances. Use alcohol hand rub for hand hygiene. Fountains and ice machines are out of service. Further guidance will come from your manager. This is not a drill.
fields.voiceDirection: Calm, clear male voice, moderate pace, slight reverb
fields.terminalAmbience: Hospital corridor background, distant intercom echoes, soft footsteps
fields.deliveryNote: Play the audio on all public address speakers. Do not explain it.
fields.scenarioTitle: Water Line, No Drink — A Regional Water Advisory That Reaches Dialysis

instructorNote: This inject confirms hospital-wide awareness of the Do Not Drink advisory. Watch for unit managers to begin circulating the same message. Infection Prevention should be ready to answer questions. The PIO must confirm consistency with public messaging.
